title: FileSearch
description: The FileSearch tool that retrieves knowledge from Semantic Retrieval corpora. Files are imported to Semantic Retrieval corpora using the ImportFile API.

topK.description: Optional. The number of semantic retrieval chunks to retrieve.

metadataFilter.description: Optional. Metadata filter to apply to the semantic retrieval documents and chunks.

fileSearchStoreNames.description: Required. The names of the file_search_stores to retrieve from. Example: `fileSearchStores/my-file-search-store-123`
